purpose: PR A of the Docket hosted beta (builds/beta/plan.md rev 4, approved by Cristian 2026-11-19): when DOCKET_ENV=beta, the public front page stays open while the review page and every API route sit behind an invite code, visitors cannot send their own documents, and every process refuses to start with an unsafe beta config. Local mode is unchanged. Nothing is deployed by this PR.
mechanism: docket/settings.py adds DOCKET_ENV (local|beta), DOCKET_INVITE_CODES, DOCKET_SESSION_KEY, DOCKET_TRUST_PROXY and DOCKET_BASE_URL. docket/beta.py holds the beta rules: code validation, the session cookie __Host-docket_session (issue time plus an HMAC over the time and the code id, keyed by DOCKET_SESSION_KEY, refused after 7 days or when its code is removed), the client address (the last X-Forwarded-For hop, only with DOCKET_TRUST_PROXY=1), the same-origin check against DOCKET_BASE_URL, the sign-in lockout (each attempt is a signin_failures row; once an address has 10 wrong codes in a rolling 60 minutes its next attempt gets 429 with Retry-After, under a per-address advisory lock; a right code deletes its row), and startup_problems/refuse_unsafe_start. docket/review_access.py: in beta, ReviewerAccess allows exactly GET /, GET /home/*, GET /healthz and POST /reviewer/session without a session; refuses any Bearer token; requires a same-origin Origin on non-GET requests; refuses POST /documents and POST /inbound with 403 before reading a body; caps other bodies at 16 KB before the handler; serves the invite-code form at /reviewer (401) when there is no session. docket/api.py adds POST /reviewer/session; review actions reject unknown actions (409) and NUL in a dismiss reason (422) in both modes before Temporal; in beta a dismiss reason is capped at 300 characters and must not be blank, and approve only takes one of the document's candidates. refuse_unsafe_start runs in the API lifespan, the worker, reconcile, eval (checking the mode it will actually run) and spike-models (checked as live). A migration creates signin_failures. web/login.html shows the token form locally and the invite-code form in beta; web/src/main.ts sends no Authorization header in beta and relies on the cookie. web/public/home/index.html's hosted-beta line invites visitors to ask for a code. tests/browser/test_beta_browser.py and web/tests/beta.spec.ts sign in with a code in a browser that shares the beta API container's network, so the Secure cookie works on localhost.
decisions: The front page stays public (Show and Try layers) and only Live sits behind the code, over rev 2's gate on every page. The cookie holds a keyed hash and an issue time, never the code, and expiry is checked by the server, over a browser-only Max-Age. The lockout count is kept in Postgres as rows in a rolling window, over an in-memory limiter (lost on restart) or a clock-hour counter (allowed 20 guesses across the hour change). Only the last forwarded hop is trusted, because Caddy appends it and anything before it is client-supplied. In beta the Bearer token is refused entirely, so there is one way in with a guess limit. A missing DOCKET_BASE_URL is not a startup refusal: every POST already fails closed (filed in builds/beta/log.md). Samples, caps, the kill switch, the nightly reset and the production compose file are PR B and PR C.
readers: README.md and docs/operations.md: people running Docket locally or as the beta, and reviewers. docs/adr: maintainers deciding later changes (ADR-009 on hosting comes in PR C, not here). Comments in docket/beta.py, docket/review_access.py, docket/api.py, docket/settings.py, web/login.html and web/src/main.ts: the next maintainer of the gate.
